// diagnostic

L0505

Heap growth in a loop after `use core.mem` — consider an arena (c26)

What

Heap growth in a loop after `use core.mem` — consider an arena (c26)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use an arena or another deliberate allocator for loop allocations.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0505: tests/ui_lint/arena_heap_loop.warn.

Warning [L0505] (heap_growth_in_loop): Heap growth inside a loop — consider an arena
  --> tests/ui_lint/arena_heap_loop.jet:5:27
    |
  5 |     loop i in 0..<4 -> xs.push(i)
    |                           ^^^^
 Why: Each `push` may allocate on the global heap; in a hot loop that adds up
 Fix: Bind `arena :: mem.Arena.new()` outside the loop and use `arena.alloc(…)` for scratch data
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0505

Warning [L0103] (unused_import): Import `mem` is never used.
  --> tests/ui_lint/arena_heap_loop.jet:1:10
    |
  1 | use core.mem
    |          ^^^
 Why: An unused import adds a name and dependency to the file without contributing to checked code.
 Fix: Remove the import, or rename `mem` to `_mem` when the import is intentionally kept.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0103
